title: John Hutchinson and the Hutchinson effect, with John Alexander showing up

tellings.quote: John Alexander also seems to show when people experience paranormal things like the Hutchinson effect. You know, John Hutchinson, California sort of, you know, metallic equipment seems to hover and like, you know, malfunction around him.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that a man named John Alexander seems to turn up when people experience paranormal things. One example, he says, is John Hutchinson in California, around whom metal equipment is said to hover and malfunction, a pattern known as the Hutchinson effect.
